slurmpilot

Auto-profiling ‘SLURM’ HPC job orchestration, ‘Apptainer’ packaging, and non-blocking ‘Shiny’ compute offloading for compute-heavy R workflows.

slurmpilot eliminates manual SLURM scripting, blind --mem/--time guessing, fragile container builds, correlated parallel RNG streams, and frozen Shiny servers for computational statistics workflows (Monte Carlo power studies, Bayesian MCMC, mixed-effects/DSEM models, and large-scale bootstraps).

Four Core Pillars

  1. Empirical Micro-Pilot Auto-Profiler & Load Balancer (pilot_run(), estimate_resources(), plan_chunks(), inspect_job_globals()): Runs a controlled sample slice in isolated child R processes (callr) while continuously sampling OS-level process-tree Resident Set Size (RSS) via ps. Separates cold startup overhead from marginal per-task runtime, fits a heavy-tail-safe walltime envelope (normal CLT + Fenton-Wilkinson log-normal sum + nonparametric tail guard), supports Longest Processing Time ("lpt") load balancing for heterogeneous workloads, and audits closures/globals for >50 MB bloat before staging.
  2. HPC Environment & Apptainer Packager (scan_project_env(), build_apptainer_def(), render_sbatch_script(), render_worker_script()): Scans renv.lock, DESCRIPTION, and R/Rmd/Quarto scripts, detects compiled toolchains (Rcpp, cmdstanr, RTMB, TMB, rstan, JAGS, sf, lme4, arrow), and emits hardened Apptainer/Singularity .def recipes, self-contained SLURM array sbatch scripts, and a zero-dependency base-R worker.R runner with independent L'Ecuyer-CMRG parallel RNG streams (slurmpilot_rng_stream()).
  3. Pluggable Scheduler Backend + Local Mock SLURM (MockSlurmBackend, SlurmSshBackend): Develop and test the entire cluster lifecycle locally via MockSlurmBackend (real parallel background R workers via processx, queue slot throttling, live RSS/timeout enforcement, atomic SHA-256 checkpoints verified by verify_checkpoint(), fault injection, and adaptive OOM/timeout retry escalation via slurm_retry() + slurm_retry_history()), then switch to SlurmSshBackend (firewall-safe SSH/SCP with bounded exponential backoff and strict CLI injection defenses) with zero workflow changes.
  4. Non-Blocking Shiny Offload Modules (mod_hpc_submit_*, mod_hpc_monitor_*, run_demo_app()): Drop-in bslib/Shiny modules executing micro-piloting and cluster submission asynchronously without freezing the Shiny session, with XSS-safe rendering, live KPI value boxes, multi-segment chunk progress bars, adaptive retry buttons, cancellation controls, and chunk logs.

Installation 

# Install development version from GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("MarcusHarrisUConn/slurmpilot")

Quick Start: Laptop Micro-Pilot to Cluster Execution 

library(slurmpilot)

# 1. Define a compute workload and audit globals/closures
args <- lapply(1:16, function(i) list(task_id = i, n = 60, delta = 0.35, reps = 60))
worker <- function(cfg) {
  rejects <- replicate(cfg$reps, {
    stats::t.test(stats::rnorm(cfg$n, cfg$delta), stats::rnorm(cfg$n, 0))$p.value < 0.05
  })
  data.frame(task_id = cfg$task_id, power = mean(rejects))
}
inspect_job_globals(worker, args_list = args)

# 2. Empirically profile 3 replications in isolated child processes
pilot <- pilot_run(worker, args, n_pilot = 3L, sample_method = "stratified", seed = 42L)

# 3. Auto-size optimal SLURM array chunking, --mem, and --time
resources <- estimate_resources(pilot, n_tasks = length(args), max_chunk_size = 4L)

# 4. Run locally on MockSlurmBackend (or switch to slurm_ssh_backend() for HPC)
backend <- mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 2L)
job <- slurm_submit(backend, worker, args, resources = resources, name = "mc_power", seed = 42L)
status <- slurm_wait(job, progress = TRUE)
results <- slurm_collect(job, simplify = TRUE)

Or run the entire pipeline—including automatic adaptive retries on OOM/timeout chunks—in a single call:

run <- slurm_autopilot(
  fun = worker,
  args_list = args,
  backend = mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 2L),
  n_pilot = 3L,
  max_chunk_size = 4L,
  auto_retry = 1L,
  simplify = TRUE
)
